Define the function to compare GSEA results

```{r gsea_comp_function }
gsea_comp <- function( enr_tbl, GO_col,
                       study1_nes, study1_sig,
                       study2_nes, study2_sig, sig_thresh = 0.05){

  terms <- enr_tbl %>%
    select(GO = all_of(GO_col),
           NES1 = all_of(study1_nes),
           PADJ1 = all_of(study1_sig),
           NES2 = all_of(study2_nes),
           PADJ2 = all_of(study2_sig)) %>%
    distinct()

  x <- tibble(
    a = terms %>%
      filter( NES1 > 0, PADJ1 <= sig_thresh, NES2 > 0, PADJ2 <= sig_thresh) %>%
      pull(GO) %>% unique() %>% length(),
    b = terms %>%
      filter( PADJ1 > sig_thresh, NES2 > 0, PADJ2 <= sig_thresh) %>%
      pull(GO) %>% unique() %>% length(),
    c = terms %>%
      filter( NES1 < 0, PADJ1 <= sig_thresh, NES2 > 0, PADJ2 <= sig_thresh) %>%
      pull(GO) %>% unique() %>% length(),
    d = terms %>%
      filter( NES1 > 0, PADJ1 <= sig_thresh, PADJ2 > sig_thresh) %>%
      pull(GO) %>% unique() %>% length(),
    e = terms %>%
      filter( PADJ1 > sig_thresh, PADJ2 > sig_thresh) %>%
      pull(GO) %>% unique() %>% length(),
    f = terms %>%
      filter( NES1 < 0, PADJ1 <= sig_thresh, PADJ2 > sig_thresh) %>%
      pull(GO) %>% unique() %>% length(),
    g = terms %>%
      filter( NES1 > 0, PADJ1 <= sig_thresh, NES2 < 0, PADJ2 <= sig_thresh) %>%
      pull(GO) %>% unique() %>% length(),
    h = terms %>%
      filter( PADJ1 > sig_thresh, NES2 < 0, PADJ2 <= sig_thresh) %>%
      pull(GO) %>% unique() %>% length(),
    i = terms %>%
      filter( NES1 < 0, PADJ1 <= sig_thresh, NES2 < 0, PADJ2 <= sig_thresh) %>%
      pull(GO) %>% unique() %>% length()
  )

  ppv = x$a/sum(x$a,x$b,x$c)
    if(is.na(ppv)){ppv = 0}
  npv = x$i/sum(x$g,x$h,x$i)
    if(is.na(npv)){npv = 0}
  ppv_c = sum(x$a, x$d, x$g)/sum(x)
    if(is.na(ppv_c)){ppv_c = 0}
  npv_c = sum(x$c, x$f, x$i)/sum(x)
    if(is.na(npv_c)){npv_c = 0}
  gain = ((ppv - ppv_c)+(npv - npv_c))/2

  mtx = rbind(c(x$a, x$b,x$c), c(x$d, x$e,x$f), c(x$g,x$h,x$i))

  tau = try(cor.test(terms$NES1, terms$NES2, meethod = 'kendall'), silent = T)
  if(class(tau) == 'try-error'){ tau = tibble(NA)
  } else { tau = broom::tidy(tau) }

  res = tibble(
    terms = list(terms), olap = list(mtx),
    ppv, ppv_c, npv, npv_c, gain,
    tau
  )

  return(res)

}

```


## AD consortium data

Grab relevant TREAT-AD data from synapse, including:

1)  Target Risk Scores ([syn25575156](https://www.synapse.org/#!Synapse:syn25575156){target="_blank"}), Genetics Scores ([syn26844312](https://www.synapse.org/#!Synapse:syn26844312){target="_blank"}), and Omics Scores ([syn22758536](https://www.synapse.org/#!Synapse:syn22758536){target="_blank"})

2)  Biodomain Definitions ([syn25428992](https://www.synapse.org/#!Synapse:syn25428992){target="_blank"})

3)  TREAT-AD score GSEA results (based on Overall, Genetics, and Omics scores) ([syn52749187](https://www.synapse.org/#!Synapse:syn52749187){target="_blank"}), and omics GSEA results (based on proteomic and transcriptomic meta-analysis logFC) ([syn52749189](https://www.synapse.org/#!Synapse:syn52749189){target="_blank"})

```{r TAD_data, message=FALSE}
# login to synapse
# synapser::synLogin()
# syn$login()

# target risk scores
scores <- syn$tableQuery(
  'select * from syn25575156',
  includeRowIdAndRowVersion = F) %>%
  .$filepath %>% read_csv(., col_types = cols())

# Genetics scores
gen <- syn$tableQuery(
  'select * from syn26844312',
  includeRowIdAndRowVersion = F) %>%
  .$filepath %>% read_csv(., col_types = cols())

# Multiomic scores
omics <- syn$tableQuery(
  'select * from syn22758536'
  , includeRowIdAndRowVersion = F
  ) %>%
  .$filepath %>% read_csv(., col_types = cols())

# Biological domain annotations
biodom <- full_join(
    # biodomains
    readRDS( syn$get('syn25428992') %>% .$path ),
    # domain labels
    read_csv( syn$get('syn26856828') %>% .$path, col_types = cols()),
    by = c('Biodomain'='domain') ) %>%
  mutate(
    Biodomain = if_else(Biodomain == 'none', NA_character_, Biodomain),
    Subdomain = if_else(is.na(Subdomain), 'none', Subdomain),
    sd = str_c(abbr,'_',Subdomain)
    )

domains = biodom %>% pull(Biodomain) %>% unique() %>% sort()

# Enriched biodomain terms
score.enr <- syn$get('syn52749187') %>% .$path %>% readRDS() 
omics.enr <- syn$get('syn52749189') %>% .$path %>% readRDS() 
```

Gather groups of GO terms based on Biodomain and Subdomain annotations

```{r}
# curate biodomain and sub-domain gene lists
bd.terms <- tibble( set = unique(biodom$Biodomain) ) %>%
  mutate( terms = map(set, ~ biodom %>% filter(Biodomain == .x) %>% pull(GO_ID)) )

sd.terms <- biodom %>%
  mutate( Subdomain = if_else(is.na(Subdomain), 'none', Subdomain) ) %>%
  select(Biodomain, abbr, Subdomain, subdomain_idx) %>% distinct() %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    set = paste0(abbr,'_',Subdomain),
    bd = Biodomain, sdi = subdomain_idx,
    terms = biodom %>% filter(Biodomain == bd, subdomain_idx == sdi) %>% pull(GO_ID) %>% list()
    )

# combine
bd.term.list = bind_rows(bd.terms, sd.terms %>% select(set, terms)) %>%
  filter(set != 'NA_none')

rm(bd.terms, sd.terms)
```

Gather groups of genes based on Biodomain & Subdomain annotations

```{r}
# curate biodomain and sub-domain gene lists
bd.genes <- tibble( set = unique(biodom$Biodomain) ) %>%
  mutate( 
    genes = map(
      set, ~ biodom %>% 
      filter(Biodomain == .x) %>% 
      pull(symbol) %>% 
      unlist
    ) 
  )

sd.genes <- biodom %>%
  mutate( Subdomain = if_else(is.na(Subdomain), 'none', Subdomain) ) %>%
  select(Biodomain, abbr, Subdomain, subdomain_idx) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    set = paste0(abbr,'_',Subdomain),
    bd = Biodomain, sdi = subdomain_idx,
    genes = biodom %>% 
    filter(Biodomain == bd, subdomain_idx == sdi) %>% 
    pull(symbol) %>% 
    unlist %>% 
    list()
  )

# combine
bd.gene.lists = bind_rows(bd.genes, sd.genes %>% select(set, genes)) %>%
  filter(set != 'NA_none')

rm(bd.genes, sd.genes)

# join with expression data
bd.genes <- omics %>% 
  select(Symbol = GName, ENSG, RNA_TE, Pro_TE) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Symbol)) %>% distinct() %>% 
  left_join(bd.gene.lists %>% unnest(genes) %>% rename(Symbol = genes),.) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Pro_TE))
```


Get [Johnson *et al*](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/instance/8825285/) module data:

```{r johnson_proteomics_modules}
# supp table:
# download.file(
  # 'https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/instance/8825285/bin/41593_2021_999_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx',
  # destfile = 'johnson_modules.xlsx')

johnson <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here('data','johnson_modules.xlsx'), sheet = 3, skip = 4)

tmt.mods <- johnson %>% 
  select(Symbol, uniprot = `Uniprot Accession`, 
         ad.ctrl = `AD-Control`, 
         asym.ctrl = `AsymAD-Control`, 
         ad.asym = `AD-AsymAD`, 
         module = `WGCNA\r\nModule|color|kME\r\nSort Vector`) %>% 
  mutate(module = str_split(module, '\\|')) %>% 
  unnest_wider(module, names_sep = '.') %>% 
  mutate(mod = str_replace(module.1, ' ', '_'))

# filter duplicate protein probes
tmt.mods <- unique(
  x = data.table(tmt.mods)[order(mod, -abs(ad.ctrl))], 
  by = c("Symbol", "mod")
)

disease.modules <- unique(tmt.mods$mod) %>% 
    str_subset(pattern = 'M42_|M11_|M24_|M7_|M25_|M3_|M5_|M8_|M1_|M20_|M2_|M29_')
```


# Plasma biomarker data
data from the biomarker SomaLogic associations
```{r}

data.dir <- list.dirs(here::here(proj.dir, 'baseline_PCs_relatedness'), recursive = F) %>% 
  str_subset(.,'.APOE') %>% str_subset(., 'relatedness\\/\\.', negate=T)

files <- map_chr(data.dir, ~list.files(.x, full.names = T) %>% 
               str_subset(.,'.csv') %>% str_subset(.,'gprofiler', negate = T))

data <- tibble( f = files ) %>% 
  mutate(file = basename(f),
         biomarker = str_extract(file, 'Plasma[_A-Za-z0-9]+(?!=.APOE.csv)') %>% 
           str_remove_all(., '_|Plasma') %>%
           str_replace_all(., 'AB140P', 'A\u03b240') %>%
           str_replace_all(., 'AB142P', 'A\u03b242') %>%
           str_replace_all(., 'PTau', 'pTau') %>%
           str_replace_all(., 'ABRatio', 'A\u03b242/A\u03b240') %>%
           str_replace_all(., 'AB42Ratio', '/A\u03b242'),
         d = map(f, ~read_csv(.x, col_types = cols()))
         ) %>% 
  select(-f) %>% 
  unnest(d) %>% 
  rename_all(.funs = ~ str_replace_all(.x,' ','_'))


```

# CSF correlations{.tabset}
```{r}

csf.mods <- read_tsv(str_c(proj.dir, 'biodomains','TMTSoma-CSF.113.one2one.Human.Genes.txt', sep = '/')) %>%
  left_join(., read_tsv(str_c(proj.dir, 'biodomains','TMTSoma-CSF.113.one2one.Human.Corr.txt', sep = '/')))
```

```{r}
model_vs_ampad <- data %>% 
  inner_join(csf.mods %>% 
               filter(!is.na(log2FC)) %>% 
               select(Symbol = symbol, mod = module, ad.ctrl = log2FC),., 
             by = 'Symbol', multiple = 'all') %>% 
  filter(!is.na(mod)) %>%
  select(mod, biomarker, Symbol, ad.ctrl, beta, t_stat, padj) %>% 
  group_by(mod, biomarker) %>% 
  nest(data = c(Symbol, ad.ctrl, beta, t_stat, padj)) %>% 
  mutate(n = map_dbl(data, ~nrow(.x)),
         group = case_when(
           biomarker %in% c('Aβ40','Aβ42') ~ 'A\u03b2',
           biomarker %in% c('pTau181','pTau217') ~ 'Tau',
           biomarker %in% c('GFAP','NfL') ~ 'NDegen',
           T ~ 'Ratio'),
         group = factor(group, levels = c('A\u03b2', 'Tau','Ratio','NDegen'))) %>% 
  filter(n > 2)

cor.df <- model_vs_ampad %>% 
  mutate(
    cor_test = map(data, ~ cor.test(.x[["t_stat"]], .x[["ad.ctrl"]], method = "pearson")),
    correlation = map_dbl(cor_test, "estimate"),
    p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, "p.value")
    ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-cor_test) %>% 
  mutate(
    significant = p_value < 0.05,
    mod_n = str_split_fixed(mod, ' ',2) %>% .[,1] %>% str_remove_all(., 'M') %>% as.numeric(),
    mod_n = if_else(is.na(mod_n), 100, mod_n),
    mod = fct_reorder(mod, mod_n))

```


```{r}
cor.df %>% arrange(desc(abs(correlation)), p_value) %>% 
  saveRDS('csf_module_biomarker_correlation.RDS')
```

```{r fig.width = 15, fig.height=6}
p = ggplot(cor.df, aes(mod, biomarker))+

print(p)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
#' Plot the correlation of markers to ref
#'
#' @param m string for the module to plot
#' @param m_col string column name with modules/biodomains
#' @param x string stat column to compare to t_stat
#' @param x_lab string for the x-axis label [default: %x]
#'
#' @return ggplot object
corr_dotplot <- function(m, m_col = 'mod', x = 'ad.ctrl', x_lab = NULL) {
  if (is.null(x_lab)) x_lab <- as.character(x)
  tmp <- data.table(unnest(cor.df, data))[get(m_col) %like% m][order(t_stat, get(x))]
  
  p <- ggplot(unique(tmp, by = c("biomarker", "Symbol")), aes(get(x), t_stat))+
    geom_point(alpha = .5)+
    geom_smooth(method = 'lm', alpha = .3, lwd = .2)+
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, lwd = .1)+
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lwd = .1)+
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
      # data = subset(tmp, !duplicated(symbol)),
      aes(label = Symbol), size = 2, alpha = .7, 
      segment.curvature = -0.1, segment.ncp = 3, segment.angle = 20,
      min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = 15)+
    facet_wrap(~biomarker, nrow = 2)+
    geom_label(size = 2.5,
             x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1, vjust = 0,
             aes( label = str_c( 'r = ', signif(correlation, digits = 3),
                                 '\np = ', signif(p_value, digits = 3),
                                 '\nn = ', n )
             )) +
    labs(x = x_lab, 
         y = 'plasma biomarker t_stat', 
         subtitle = str_c(#g,'\n',
                          cor.df[[m_col]][grep(m,cor.df[[m_col]])]))
  return(p)
}

```

```{r csf_mods, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
terms <- c(
  'M1 ', 'M2 ', 'M3 ', 'M4 ', 'M5 ', 'M7 ', 'M11 ', 'M13 ', 'M15 ', 'M17 ', 
  'M18 ', 'M20 ', 'M21 ', 'M22 ', 'M25 ', 'M26 ', 'M27 ', 'M32 ', 'M33 ', 'M34 '

  # header name
```

# Johnson module correlations{.tabset}

Here we're going to compare protein changes to postmortem human brain case vs control. We'll focus on subsets of proteins defined by protein co-expression modules identified in postmortem human brain ([Johnson *et al*](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/instance/8825285/) modules). 

```{r}
model_vs_ampad <- data %>% 
  inner_join(tmt.mods %>% select(Symbol, mod, ad.ctrl),., 
             by = 'Symbol', multiple = 'all') %>% 
  filter(!is.na(mod)) %>%
  select(mod, biomarker, Symbol, ad.ctrl, beta, t_stat, padj) %>% 
  group_by(mod, biomarker) %>% 
  nest(data = c(Symbol, ad.ctrl, beta, t_stat, padj)) %>% 
  mutate(n = map_dbl(data, ~nrow(.x)),
         group = case_when(
           biomarker %in% c('Aβ40','Aβ42') ~ 'A\u03b2',
           biomarker %in% c('pTau181','pTau217') ~ 'Tau',
           biomarker %in% c('GFAP','NfL') ~ 'NDegen',
           T ~ 'Ratio'
         ),
         group = factor(group, levels = c('A\u03b2', 'Tau','Ratio','NDegen'))) %>% 
  filter(n > 3)

cor.df <- model_vs_ampad %>% 
  mutate(
    cor_test = map(data, ~ cor.test(.x[["t_stat"]], .x[["ad.ctrl"]], method = "pearson")),
    correlation = map_dbl(cor_test, "estimate"),
    p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, "p.value")
    ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-cor_test) %>% 
  mutate(
    significant = p_value < 0.05,
    mod_n = str_split_fixed(mod, '_',2) %>% .[,1] %>% str_remove_all(., 'M') %>% as.numeric(),
    mod_n = if_else(is.na(mod_n), 100, mod_n),
    mod = fct_reorder(mod, mod_n))

dz.cor.df <- cor.df %>% filter(mod %in% disease.modules) 
```

```{r}
cor.df %>% arrange(desc(abs(correlation)), p_value) %>% 
  saveRDS('tmt_module_biomarker_correlation.RDS')
```

```{r tmt_mods, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Module dotplots that are significant
terms <- c(
  'M7_', 'M9_', 'M17_', 'M20_', 'M22_', 'M23_', 'M25_', 'M26_', 'M27_', 'M28_', 
  'M29_', 'M30_', 'M32_', 'M33_', 'M35_', 'M36_', 'M37_', 'M42_'

invisible(lapply(seq(terms), function(i) {
  
  # header name
  cat("  \n##",  gsub("_", "", terms[i]), "  \n")

    )
  )

  plot.new()
  dev.off()
  cat("  \n  \n")  

}))

```




# Biodomain protein correlation {.tabset}

Here we're going to correlate protein expression changes in biomarker with postmortem human brain samples, partitioned by biological domain (biodomain) and sub-domain rather than protein co-expression modules.

```{r}
sig = 1.5

model_vs_ampad <- data %>% 
  select(biomarker, Symbol, beta, t_stat, padj) %>% distinct() %>% 
  inner_join(bd.genes,., multiple = 'all') %>% 
  filter(!is.na(set), padj <= sig) %>% 
  group_by(set, biomarker) %>% 
  nest(data = c(Symbol, ENSG, beta, t_stat, padj, RNA_TE, Pro_TE)) %>% 
  mutate(
    data = map(data, ~distinct(.x)),
    group = case_when(
       biomarker %in% c('Aβ40','Aβ42') ~ 'A\u03b2',
       biomarker %in% c('pTau181','pTau217') ~ 'Tau',
       biomarker %in% c('GFAP','NfL') ~ 'NDegen',
       T ~ 'Ratio'),
    group = factor(group, levels = c('A\u03b2', 'Tau','Ratio','NDegen')),
    n = map_dbl(data, ~nrow(.x))) %>% 
  filter(n > 3)

cor.df <- model_vs_ampad %>% 
  mutate(
    cor_test = map(data, ~ cor.test(.x[["t_stat"]], 
                                    .x[["Pro_TE"]], 
                                    method = "pearson")),
    correlation = map_dbl(cor_test, "estimate"),
    p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, "p.value")
    ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-cor_test) %>% 
  mutate(significant = p_value < 0.05) 

```

```{r}
cor.df %>% arrange(desc(abs(correlation)), p_value) %>% 
  saveRDS('biodomain_biomarker_correlation.RDS')
```

# GSEA

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
gsea <- data %>% 
  # mutate(signedP = -log10(padj)*sign(beta)) %>% 
  group_by(biomarker) %>% 
  arrange(desc(t_stat)) %>% 
  summarise( gl = t_stat %>% setNames(., Symbol) %>% list() ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    res = map(gl, ~ clusterProfiler::gseGO(
      .x, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, 
      keyType = 'SYMBOL', eps = 0, pvalueCutoff = 1))
  )
```

## Biodomain Enrichment

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=6, warning=FALSE}
sig = 0.05

tmp <- gsea %>% 
  mutate(r = map(res, ~.x@result)) %>% 
  select(-gl, -res) %>% 
  unnest(r) %>% 
  left_join(., biodom %>% select(ID = GO_ID, Biodomain:Subdomain, abbr:sd)) %>% 
  mutate(Biodomain = if_else(is.na(Biodomain), 'none', Biodomain),
         color = if_else(is.na(color), 'grey30', color),
         n_sig = length(ID[p.adjust <= sig]), 
         med_nes = median(NES[p.adjust <= sig]),
         .by = Biodomain) %>% 
  mutate(med_nes = if_else(is.na(med_nes), 0, med_nes),
         Biodomain = fct_reorder(Biodomain, n_sig))
  
ggplot(tmp, aes(NES, Biodomain))+
  facet_wrap(~biomarker, ncol = 4)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, lwd = .1)+
  geom_jitter(data = subset(tmp, p.adjust > sig), 
             color = 'grey80', alpha = .3, size = .2)+
  geom_jitter(data = subset(tmp, p.adjust <= sig), 
             aes(color = color),
             alpha = .3)+
  geom_violin(data = subset(tmp, p.adjust <= sig & NES > 0),
              aes(color = color, fill = color),
              alpha = .1, scale = 'width', draw_quantiles = .5)+
  geom_violin(data = subset(tmp, p.adjust <= sig & NES < 0),
              aes(color = color, fill = color),
              alpha = .1, scale = 'width', draw_quantiles = .5)+
  scale_color_identity()+scale_fill_identity()+
  labs(y = '',
       subtitle = str_c('terms enriched @ adjusted p < ',sig))
```

## GSEA comparison{.tabset}

```{r}
sig = .1

oe <- omics.enr %>% 
  filter(score == 'Pro_TE') %>% 
  select(score,anno) %>% 
  unnest(anno)

vs.omics <- gsea %>% 
  mutate(r = map(res, ~.x@result)) %>% 
  select(-gl, -res) %>% 
  unnest(r) %>% 
  select(biomarker, term = ID, dx.nes = NES, dx.padj = p.adjust) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  nest( data = -c(biomarker) ) %>%
  mutate(
    data = map(
      data,
      ~ full_join(
        oe %>% select(term = GO_ID, amp.nes = NES, amp.padj = p.adjust) %>% distinct(),
        .x, by = 'term', na_matches = 'never') %>%
        mutate(
          across(contains('padj'), ~ if_else(is.na(.x), 1, .x)),
          across(contains('nes'), ~ if_else(is.na(.x), 0, .x)),
          dx.nes = if_else(dx.padj > sig, 0, dx.nes),
          amp.nes = if_else(amp.padj > sig, 0, amp.nes)
          )
    )) 

sink('/dev/null')
all = map(vs.omics$biomarker,
          ~ vs.omics %>% filter(biomarker == .x) %>% pull(data) %>% .[[1]] %>%
            gsea_comp(., 'term', 'amp.nes', 'amp.padj', 'dx.nes', 'dx.padj', sig_thresh = sig) )

no_bd = map(vs.omics$biomarker,
            ~ vs.omics %>% filter(biomarker == .x) %>% pull(data) %>% .[[1]] %>%
                filter((term %in% biodom$GO_ID)==F) %>%
                gsea_comp(., 'term', 'amp.nes', 'amp.padj', 'dx.nes', 'dx.padj', 
                          sig_thresh = sig) )

comp <- crossing(model = vs.omics$biomarker, set = bd.term.list$set) %>%
  mutate(
    res = map2(
      model, set,
      ~ vs.omics %>% filter(biomarker == .x) %>% pull(data) %>% .[[1]] %>%
          filter(term %in% bd.term.list$terms[[which(bd.term.list$set == .y)]]) %>%
          gsea_comp(., 'term', 'amp.nes', 'amp.padj', 'dx.nes', 'dx.padj', sig_thresh = sig)
      )) %>%
  bind_rows(
    .,
    tibble(model = vs.omics$biomarker, set = 'All Terms', res = all),
    tibble(model = vs.omics$biomarker, set = 'No Biodomain', res = no_bd)
    ) %>%
  unnest(res) %>%
  mutate(
    n.sig = map_dbl(terms, ~ .x %>% filter(PADJ1 <= sig | PADJ2 <= sig) %>% nrow()),
    n.sig.1 = map_dbl(terms, ~ .x %>% filter(PADJ1 <= sig) %>% nrow()),
    n.sig.2 = map_dbl(terms, ~ .x %>% filter(PADJ2 <= sig) %>% nrow()),
    n.sig.both = map_dbl(terms, ~ .x %>% filter(PADJ1 <= sig, PADJ2 <= sig) %>% nrow()),
    n.terms = map_dbl(olap,~sum(.x)),
    norm.gain = (n.sig.1*(gain/100))/n.terms,

    tau.padj = p.adjust(p.value, method = 'BH'),
    tau.padj = if_else(tau.padj == 0, min(tau.padj[tau.padj>0], na.rm =T), tau.padj),
    significant = tau.padj <= 0.05,
    group = case_when(
      model %in% c('AB140P','AB142P','ABRatio') ~ 'A\u03b2',
      model %in% c('PTau181','pTau217') ~ 'Tau',
      model %in% c('GFAP','NfL') ~ 'NDegen',
      T ~ 'Ratio'),
    group = factor(group, levels = c('A\u03b2', 'Tau','Ratio','NDegen'))
    )
sink()

```

# Biomarker x Biomarker correlations

## protein{.tabset}

```{r}
cor_combined <- function(data, mapping, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs", maxPointSize = 25, digits = 2, ...) {
  
  # Extract x and y variable names from mapping
  x_var_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_var_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)
  
  # Extract x and y data using the variable names
  x <- data[[x_var_name]]
  y <- data[[y_var_name]]
  
  # Check if data is numeric
  if(is.numeric(x) & is.numeric(y)){
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor <- cor(x, y, method = method, use = use)
    
    # Calculate color based on correlation
    colFn <- colorRampPalette(c("#85070C", "white", "#164B6E"), interpolate = "spline")
    
    # Calculate point size based on absolute correlation
    abs_cor <- abs(cor)
    
    # Create a 1-row data frame for geom_point
    df <- data.frame(x = 0, y = 0)
    df$cor_color <- cor
    df$cor_size <- abs_cor
    
    # Calculate correlation and p-value using rcorr (from Hmisc)
    rcorr_result <- Hmisc::rcorr(x, y, type = method)
    
    # Format correlation text with significance stars using code from GGally
    cor_p <- rcorr_result$P[1, 2]
    cor_coef <- signif(rcorr_result$r[1, 2], digits = digits)
    cor_text <- as.character(round(cor_coef, 2))
    
    # Determine significance stars
    sig_stars <- symnum(cor_p, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE, 
                        cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1), 
                        symbols = c("***", "**", "*", ".", " "))
    cor_text <- paste(cor_text, sig_stars, sep = "")
    
    # Create a grob for the correlation text
    cor_grob <- grid::textGrob(label = cor_text,
                               gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 10))
    
    # Create a plot for the point layer
    point_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = cor_color, size = cor_size), alpha = .5, ...) +
      scale_color_gradientn(colours = colFn(100), limits = c(-1, 1)) +
      scale_size_area(max_size = maxPointSize, limits = c(0, 1)) +
      guides(color = "none", size = "none") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
            axis.title = element_blank(),
            axis.text = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks = element_blank())
    
    # Add the annotation layer with the correlation text
    final_plot <- point_plot +
      annotation_custom(grob = cor_grob, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)
    
    return(final_plot)
    
  } else {
    # Return an empty plot for non-numeric data using ggally_blank
    return(GGally::ggally_blank(data, mapping))
  }
}
```

```{r}

bm_vs_bm <- inner_join(
    data %>% select(biomarker, Symbol, t_stat) %>% distinct(),
    data %>% select(biomarker, Symbol, t_stat) %>% distinct(),
    by = 'Symbol') %>%
  mutate(
    bm.1 = if_else(biomarker.x > biomarker.y, biomarker.y, biomarker.x),
    bm.2= if_else(biomarker.x > biomarker.y, biomarker.x, biomarker.y),
    t_stat.1 = if_else(biomarker.x > biomarker.y, t_stat.y, t_stat.x),
    t_stat.2= if_else(biomarker.x > biomarker.y, t_stat.x, t_stat.y)
  ) %>%
  select(-biomarker.x, -biomarker.y, -t_stat.x, -t_stat.y) %>% distinct() %>% 
  left_join(.,bd.genes %>% select(Symbol, set)) %>% 
  group_by(set, bm.1, bm.2) %>% 
  nest(data = c(Symbol, t_stat.1, t_stat.2)) %>% 
  mutate(
    data = map(data, ~distinct(.x)),
    n = map_dbl(data, ~nrow(.x))
    ) %>% 
  filter(bm.1!=bm.2, n > 10) %>% 
  mutate( 
    cor_test = map(data, ~cor.test(.x[['t_stat.1']], .x[['t_stat.2']], method = 'pearson')),
    correlation = map_dbl(cor_test, "estimate"),
    p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, "p.value")
    )
```

## enriched terms{.tabset}

```{r}
cor_combined <- function(data, mapping, method = "kendall", use = "pairwise.complete.obs", maxPointSize = 25, digits = 2, minObs = 5, ...) {
  
  # Extract x and y variable names from mapping
  x_var_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_var_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)
  
  # Extract x and y data using the variable names
  x <- data[[x_var_name]]
  y <- data[[y_var_name]]
  
  # Check if data is numeric
  if(is.numeric(x) & is.numeric(y)){
    
    # Count non-NA values
    non_na_count <- sum(complete.cases(x, y))
    
    # If not enough observations, return ggally_blank
    if (non_na_count < minObs) {
      return(GGally::ggally_blank(data, mapping))
    }
    
    # Initialize cor_text for error handling
    cor_text <- "NA"
    
    # Try to calculate the correlation and handle errors
    tryCatch({
      # Calculate correlation
      cor <- cor(x, y, method = method, use = use)
      
      # Calculate p-value using cor.test for Kendall's method
      if (method == "kendall") {
        cor_test_result <- cor.test(x, y, method = "kendall", exact = FALSE)
        cor_p <- cor_test_result$p.value
      } else {
        # Use Hmisc::rcorr for Pearson or Spearman
        rcorr_result <- Hmisc::rcorr(x, y, type = method)
        cor_p <- rcorr_result$P[1, 2]
      }
      
      # Format correlation text with significance stars
      cor_coef <- signif(cor, digits = digits)
      cor_text <- as.character(round(cor_coef, 2))
      
      # Determine significance stars
      sig_stars <- symnum(cor_p, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE, 
                          cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1), 
                          symbols = c("***", "**", "*", ".", " "))
      cor_text <- paste(cor_text, sig_stars, sep = "")
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      # Print the error message
      cat("Error during correlation calculation:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
      # Set cor_text to "NA" (or any other value indicating an error)
      cor_text <<- "NA"
    })
    
    # Check if cor_text is still "NA" after tryCatch
    if (cor_text == "NA") {
      return(GGally::ggally_blank(data, mapping))
    }
    
    # Calculate color based on correlation
    colFn <- colorRampPalette(c("#85070C", "white", "#164B6E"), interpolate = "spline")
    
    # Calculate point size based on absolute correlation
    abs_cor <- abs(cor)
    
    # Create a 1-row data frame for geom_point
    df <- data.frame(x = 0, y = 0)
    df$cor_color <- cor
    df$cor_size <- abs_cor
    
    # Create a grob for the correlation text
    cor_grob <- grid::textGrob(label = cor_text,
                               gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 10))
    
    # Create a plot for the point layer
    point_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = cor_color, size = cor_size), ...) +
      scale_color_gradientn(colours = colFn(100), limits = c(-1, 1)) +
      scale_size_area(max_size = maxPointSize, limits = c(0, 1)) +
      guides(color = "none", size = "none") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
            axis.title = element_blank(),
            axis.text = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks = element_blank())
    
    # Add the annotation layer with the correlation text
    final_plot <- point_plot +
      annotation_custom(grob = cor_grob, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)
    
    return(final_plot)
    
  } else {
    # Return an empty plot for non-numeric data using ggally_blank
    return(GGally::ggally_blank(data, mapping))
  }
}
```
